reading: The RTL declares 8 state codes at Hamming distance >= 3. On both netlists every state register still has 6 flops and every code seen in random fault-free simulation is one of the RTL codes: the encoding itself survived synthesis. The recorded SAT analysis agrees for faults on the state flops (3 flips = the code distance on the single-rail netlist) and finds cheaper attacks through combinational cells (1 flip single rail, 2 flips three rails from reset). That drop is outside what the structural encoding check sees; it is a margin result. The checker therefore does NOT by itself flag a 3-to-2 weakening on these netlists.
